svg.title: greek-spiral bore - section 1 of 1, sheet 1 of 2, bend DDDDDDDDDDLLLLLLLLLUUUUUURRRRRDDLLLDDRRRRRUUUUUULLLLLLLLLDDDDDDDDDD~a~b, 13 parts on 592x285mm
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. 10mm square bore in 3mm stock, so a 16mm block pitch; a block that runs straight is 16mm long and a block that turns is a 16mm cube. Blocks 1-68 of the walk, entering on N and leaving on N, a 12x13 block plate laid flat. Two face plates (mirror images) and the side walls; every part carries the section number only. Inner cuts are the port and come before their outline. black #000000 cuts, blue #0000ff engraves.
